findings.title: Excess INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE grants on every warehouse view
findings.root_cause: Supabase platform-level ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES on the public schema, not any project migration
findings.exploitability: None in practice — every affected view is a JOIN without an INSTEAD OF trigger, so Postgres already rejects real writes. Fixed anyway for explicit policy over implementation-detail safety.

findings.title: Application tables (portfolio_properties, watchlist_items, etc.) carry full anon/authenticated CRUD grants
findings.reason: Branch is a full structural clone of production; these tables are unrelated to and untouched by any warehouse migration. Changing their RLS/grants is a separate, production-facing decision requiring explicit human review, not something to change unilaterally inside a warehouse-focused audit.

findings.title: get_market_timeseries_v1/v2 have no explicit row cap
findings.reason: Self-limiting in practice (single geography_id scope tops out at a few hundred rows) but not an enforced cap the way every other function has.

non_findings_reviewed: rls_auto_enable — Supabase platform event trigger, not project code, not directly exploitable
set_updated_at — standard trigger helper, PUBLIC execute is Postgres default and harmless outside actual trigger context
core/mart/meta schema direct access — confirmed zero grants to anon/authenticated
SQL injection resistance — all functions use typed parameter binding, no dynamic SQL from user input
bounded response sizes — every function with an unbounded-result risk has an enforced cap except SEC-003

rls_decision.decision: RLS remains disabled on all 44 core/mart/meta/staging tables — deliberate, re-confirmed
rls_decision.rationale: No natural per-row ownership concept for research facts; schema-level exposure hiding (zero grants to anon/authenticated on the underlying schemas, narrow public.* surface) achieves the same deny-by-default goal at the correct layer

environment_variable_review.WAREHOUSE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: public by design, server-only usage confirmed by code review
environment_variable_review.WAREHOUSE_VALIDATION_DB_URL: never printed by any script, confirmed by code review; not present in any client bundle
environment_variable_review.service_role_key_usage: none found anywhere in warehouse code
